about: Havenbrooke's Life Cards (dungeon/life/cards.py, docs/life-cards.md): events drawn into campus days, drives and bus rides, nights in the dorm and off-page beats for the people the player is not with. A first pass; the Companion modern everyday deck (world/data/life_deck.json) is the base for a fuller one. Fields as in the Vallarith deck.

cards.title: Free pizza at the Senate meeting
cards.truth: The Student Senate over-ordered for a meeting nobody came to.
cards.seen: Twelve boxes of pizza on a table in Morrowe with a sign that says TAKE IT. People are taking it.

cards.title: Buyback week
cards.truth: The campus bookstore is short on used copies and paying double for them.
cards.seen: The bookstore is buying textbooks back at real prices for once. The line goes out the door.

cards.title: A good morning
cards.truth: Nothing in particular. The light was good and nobody needed anything.
cards.seen: The coffee line is short, the Quad smells like cut grass and leaves, and {pc} has nowhere to be for an hour.

cards.title: A study group that works
cards.truth: Three people from the same section all need the same notes.
cards.seen: Someone from class asks {pc} to join a study group in the library, and it turns out to be useful.

cards.title: Market morning
cards.truth: The dryad co-op had a good harvest and is giving samples away.
cards.seen: The Saturday Market is packed. The dryad stall is handing out jars of preserves that taste like late summer.

cards.title: A twenty in a library book
cards.truth: A professor used a twenty-dollar bill as a bookmark in 1998 and forgot it.
cards.seen: A twenty-dollar bill falls out of a library book, soft from years between the pages.

cards.title: A ticket
cards.truth: Haven PD writes tickets on Lantern Way in September to fund the overtime budget.
cards.seen: Campus security is writing tickets on every car on the Row, and a few people who are only walking past.

cards.title: Something going round
cards.truth: A stomach bug came back from a weekend at Seneca Lake with half a fraternity.
cards.seen: Half the lecture hall is coughing. Evermere has a line, and the pharmacy is out of the good cold medicine.

cards.title: The laundry vanishes
cards.truth: A freshman took the wrong load from the dryer, then got embarrassed and kept it.
cards.seen: Someone took {pc}'s laundry out of the dryer, every piece of it.

cards.title: The ward inspection
cards.truth: The DED is doing its annual review of the residence wards and running behind.
cards.seen: Facilities is testing the dorm wards all day. Every door hums, the elevator is off, and nobody can sleep.

cards.title: A pop quiz
cards.truth: The professor was told at a faculty meeting that attendance is down.
cards.seen: A pop quiz, ten questions, in a class {pc} did not do the reading for.

cards.title: A dead phone
cards.truth: The charger cable frayed. Nothing more.
cards.seen: {pc}'s phone dies at noon with three missed texts on it, and the charger is in the other bag.

cards.title: Tagged
cards.truth: Someone posted forty photos from Friday, and three of them show more than anyone agreed to.
cards.seen: Facebook says {pc} has been tagged in a new album. The comments are already going.
cards.pressure: {npc} wants to know who took the one by the stairs.

cards.title: The Oracle runs a story
cards.truth: The Oracle has a source inside the {faction}, and the source is angry.
cards.seen: The new Oracle is on every table in Morrowe with a front-page story about the {faction}. Half of it is true.

cards.title: A party on Elm
cards.truth: Four juniors split a keg and invited everyone, and the house is two floors over code.
cards.seen: There is a party on Elm tonight. Everyone is going; the question is who {pc} goes with.
cards.pressure: {npc} asks {pc} to come, and makes it clear it is not as friends.

cards.title: An aura spill
cards.truth: A demonkin student skipped a feed for two weeks to make a point, and lost the point in a lecture hall.
cards.seen: The air in the lecture hall goes warm and heavy for a full minute, and every human in the room forgets what they were saying.

cards.title: A conduct review
cards.truth: Someone filed a complaint about the {faction}, and the Dean's office has to be seen to act.
cards.seen: An email from the Dean of Student Life asks {pc} to come in Thursday to "talk about the weekend."
cards.pressure: {npc} begs {pc} not to mention their name.

cards.title: Too long a kiss
cards.truth: An incubus drew too hard at a party and a human girl went under for four minutes. He drove her to Evermere himself.
cards.seen: An ambulance outside a West Haven house at two in the morning, and a crowd that stops talking when anyone asks.
cards.pressure: {npc} was there, and wants {pc} to say they were not.

cards.title: A night at the Velvet Spire
cards.truth: The Spire waived cover for a feeding-needs night, and the middle floor is full of people who came to be fed on.
cards.seen: The line at the Velvet Spire goes round the block. The bouncer is letting in pairs.
cards.pressure: {npc} hands {pc} a wristband for the middle floor and does not explain it.

cards.title: Something in the cup
cards.truth: Someone at the party is dosing cups with a fae euphoric that does not show on any test.
cards.seen: Two girls at the party are giggling at nothing and cannot stand up, and the guy who brought them drinks has left.
cards.pressure: One of them grabs {pc}'s sleeve and asks to be taken home, now.

cards.title: Three in the morning
cards.truth: Something has been sitting on {bond} for weeks, and tonight it comes out.
cards.seen: {bond} knocks at three in the morning, sits down on the end of the bed and says they need to tell {pc} something.

cards.title: A letter about money
cards.truth: A parent lost a job in the summer layoffs and has not said so.
cards.seen: The financial aid office sends a letter: a scholarship has been "restructured" for spring.

cards.title: A glamour slips
cards.truth: Someone on the floor is not what their glamour says, and tonight it slipped in front of {pc}.
cards.seen: For a second, across the common room, someone {pc} knows has the wrong eyes.
cards.pressure: {npc} asks very quietly what {pc} thinks they saw.

cards.title: The shuttle is on time
cards.truth: The new driver takes the back road and does not stop for coffee.
cards.seen: The shuttle is early, warm, and nearly empty. Someone left a Sunday paper on the seat.

cards.title: Peak color
cards.truth: It is the second week of October.
cards.seen: The hills along the road are red and gold all the way to the lake.

cards.title: A good rest stop
cards.truth: The Stewart's at the halfway point just put in a new coffee machine.
cards.seen: The gas station halfway there has hot coffee, clean bathrooms and a cashier who calls everyone hon.

cards.title: A flat
cards.truth: A nail from a roofing job on Route 13 has been in the tire since Haven.
cards.seen: The car pulls hard to the right, then thumps. A flat, and the spare is a doughnut.

cards.title: The bus is late
cards.truth: The bus broke down in Binghamton and the company did not tell anyone.
cards.seen: The bus is ninety minutes late, then two hours, and the station has one working vending machine.

cards.title: Lake-effect snow
cards.truth: A band of lake-effect snow came off Ontario an hour early.
cards.seen: The snow comes in sideways at the county line. Everyone slows to thirty and nobody can see the lines.

cards.title: Pulled over
cards.truth: The trooper is bored and the car has an expired inspection sticker.
cards.seen: Lights in the mirror. A state trooper takes a long look at the license and a longer look at the back seat.

cards.title: Someone on the shoulder
cards.truth: The woman on the shoulder is a leanan sidhe walking home from a man she fed on for a year.
cards.seen: A woman in a thin coat is walking the shoulder in the cold with no bag, and she looks up as the car slows.

cards.title: A deer
cards.truth: A buck came out of the trees at dusk, as they do every October.
cards.seen: A deer in the headlights, then the sound of it on the hood. The car is drivable. The deer is not.

cards.title: A quiet night
cards.truth: Nothing happens. The floor is asleep.
cards.seen: The common room is dark and quiet, and for once {pc} sleeps all the way through.

cards.title: Talking until four
cards.truth: Neither of them could sleep, for different reasons.
cards.seen: Someone is still up in the common room at two, and the conversation goes until the windows turn gray.

cards.title: The fire alarm
cards.truth: A phoenix-blooded sophomore on two had a very good night.
cards.seen: The fire alarm goes at three in the morning. Everyone stands on the lawn in socks for forty minutes.

cards.title: Noise through the wall
cards.truth: The couple in the next unit got back together tonight.
cards.seen: The wall is thin and the neighbors are not quiet. Sleep comes at about four.

cards.title: A Nexus dream
cards.truth: The ley node under the building pushes dreams into anyone sleeping lightly, and some of them belong to other people.
cards.seen: {pc} dreams something vivid and specific about someone on the floor, and wakes up not sure whose dream it was.

cards.title: Someone in the dream
cards.truth: A demonkin student on the floor below has been dreamwalking without asking.
cards.seen: The dream has a stranger in it who knows {pc}'s name and keeps asking what {pc} wants.

cards.title: A good grade
cards.truth: {them} got an A on a paper they wrote in one night.
cards.seen: {them} is in a very good mood and will tell anyone why.

cards.title: A new job
cards.truth: {them} picked up shifts at the Stag & Thistle.
cards.seen: {them} has a new job and smells like fryer oil when they get home.

cards.title: A bad call home
cards.truth: {them} had a phone call with a parent that went the way they always go.
cards.seen: {them} comes back from a walk with red eyes and says it was the wind.

cards.title: The ex comes back
cards.truth: {them} ran into an ex at Midnight Gas and stayed until four.
cards.seen: {them} has been checking their phone all day and putting it face down.

cards.title: A night out
cards.truth: {them} went home with someone from the Velvet Spire, and it was good, and it was complicated.
cards.seen: {them} comes in at nine in the morning in last night's clothes, very pleased and saying nothing.

cards.title: A summons
cards.truth: The {faction} called {them} in and asked for something they have not told anyone about.
cards.seen: {them} has a meeting they will not explain, and comes back from it quiet.

cards.title: A bad night
cards.truth: {them} got into a fight at an Alpha Gamma party and lost.
cards.seen: {them} has a split lip and a story about a door.

cards.title: A lost weekend
cards.truth: {them} has been using a fae euphoric to sleep, and then to get up.
cards.seen: {them} missed two classes and says it was the flu.
